calculation.description: Crash-asymmetry gauge: ratio of downside to upside semi-deviation over 20d minus 1. Assets dominated by large negative moves (ratio > 0) underperform over 10d; negative IC stable across all three regimes.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the 15-asset cross-asset universe; 980 IC dates with >=8 valid instruments. Regime ICs: {"2020-2022": -0.05, "2023-2024": -0.0215, "2025-2026": -0.0857}. Max abs IC correlation with decodable library factors: 0.505 (vs mom_10d_skip5).

signal_artifact.description: Factor signal panel: rows = dates (YYYY-MM-DD), cols = 15 watchlist symbols. Recover with zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(data)).decode() -> pandas.read_csv(StringIO).
